articles.summary: CRA supported Lesaffre in its acquisitions of DSM-Firmenich’s yeast extract business and its joint venture with Zilor Group. Lesaffre acquired a 70% stake in Biorigin, Zilor’s yeast extract based in Brazil, involving merger control clearances in Brazil, Germany and the UK. articles.title: CRA advises Lesaffre on yeast extract acquisitions and global merger clearances
